senses.gloss: m. (פשך, cmp. פשח to split, part) [spread fingers,] hand-breadth, palm (cmp. פַּרְסָה II).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:25">Targ. Ex. XXV, 25</cite> (Y. II <cite ref="I00200"><he>טוֹפַח</he></cite>). Ib. XXXVII, 12 (not <cite ref="Q02082"><he>פְּשַׂךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 40:5">Targ. Ez. XL, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:42">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 42</cite> (ed. Diehrenf. <cite ref="Q00400"><he>פּוּשְׁחָא</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="S00592"><he>קוֹרְטָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>פּוּשְׁכִּין</he>, <he>פּוּשְׁכַּיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q00401"><he>פּוּשְׁכֵּי</he></cite>.

Targ. I Kings VII, 9 (projections, eaves; h. text טפחות). Targ. Y. Lev. l. c. (ed. Diehrenfurt פּוּשְׁחֵי); a. e.—Y. Succ. III, beg. 53ᶜ פ׳ רברבין large (wide) handbreadths; פ׳ דקיקין small (narrow) handbreadths (v. טֶפַח, a. עָצֵב). Bab.
